papers.title: Learning Dynamics of Strategic Publishers in Generative AI Ecosystems
papers.titleZh: 生成式AI生态系统中战略性发布者的学习动态
papers.abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) search systems are transforming how users access information. Unlike ranking-based search systems, where users observe a ranked list of documents, GenAI search systems, given a user's question, generate an answer, often accompanied by external sources (e.g., in the form of citations). Content creators (publishers) seeking to increase exposure might behave strategically and compete with other creators for users' attention. While publishers in ranking-based systems might strategically modify their content to improve its ranking, the incentives in generative systems take on a new form. Publishers may now gain exposure through generated responses and attributions to those responses. We introduce a novel game-theoretic model of the emerging GenAI ecosystem in which publishers compete for attribution-based exposure. We study the learning dynamics of strategic content creators under better-response dynamics. We associate the convergence of learning dynamics to equilibrium with ecosystem stability. Employing the notion of potential games, we study the stability of GenAI ecosystems under several known content selection mechanisms. We demonstrate the instability of mechanisms representing real-world modern systems and characterize a mechanism that induces a stable ecosystem. We conduct extensive simulations to analyze the stability and welfare of GenAI ecosystems under various mechanisms. The simulations support our theoretical findings and reveal an interplay among stability, publisher welfare, and user welfare. In particular, stable mechanisms do not necessarily maximize welfare, demonstrating an important trade-off for platform designers. We then introduce a study illustrating that the proper selection of the GenAI mechanism enables the manifestation of desired trade-offs between publisher welfare and the different sources of user welfare.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 随着生成式AI搜索系统（如ChatGPT）普及，内容创作者不再仅通过排名竞争曝光，而是通过被AI引用获得关注。这改变了传统搜索中的激励结构，引发新的策略行为：发布者可能修改内容以提高被引用概率。本文关注这种‘引用驱动’的竞争下，系统是否能稳定收敛，以及不同机制如何影响平台生态的整体福利。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 文章构建了一个博弈论模型，其中多个发布者选择文档向量以影响生成响应和自身被引概率。用户提问后，平台基于检索增强生成（RAG）合成答案，并采用特定归因机制分配引用权重。发布者效用由归因得分减去偏离原始内容的成本构成，学习过程遵循改进响应动态，即只要有利可图就会调整策略。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 研究发现，只有当使用全部发布者内容进行生成且采用线性归因机制时，系统才能保证学习动态收敛至纯纳什均衡。常见的argmax和softmax归因机制可能导致循环波动甚至不收敛。然而，不稳定机制在某些情况下反而能带来更高的社会总福利，揭示了稳定性与效率之间的根本权衡。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者利用势博弈理论分析收敛性，通过构造精确势函数证明线性机制在全量参与下的稳定性。对于非势博弈情形，则借助仿真验证长期行为趋势。结合理论证明与大规模模拟，系统评估了不同归因函数、上下文大小和参数设置对稳定性和各类福利指标的影响。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型假设发布者完全理性且信息透明，忽略了认知成本与信息不对称，机制也依赖全局访问所有内容，在现实中受限于检索效率。尽管如此，该文首次形式化了生成式AI中的归因竞争，其核心洞见——稳定机制未必最优——对平台设计具有指导意义，值得重视机制设计中的多维权衡。

papers.title: Optimistic Verifiable Claims: A Blockchain Protocol for Conditionally Confidential Bidding in Decentralized Manufacturing
papers.titleZh: 乐观可验证声明：一种用于去中心化制造中条件保密投标的区块链协议
papers.abstract: Decentralized manufacturing faces a pre-contractual impasse: a Provider cannot price a service accurately without inspecting the design file, yet the Consumer cannot share that file without exposing intellectual property. We introduce the Optimistic Verifiable Claim (OVC), a blockchain protocol that lets a Consumer publish a verifiable claim about a concealed design (such as the material it consumes) and a Provider price and bid on it without seeing the design. The claim is committed when the service is posted and stands unless the selected Provider challenges it; a challenge triggers a deterministic on-chain check that exposes any dishonesty, and the design is disclosed only to settle a dispute, never on the honest path. We implement four checks (authorized key access, delivery-channel integrity, syntactic conformance, and declared material consumption) in Solidity and measure them on a real 6.41 MB G-code file, the 3DBenchy, across Ethereum, Arbitrum, and opBNB. Every service incurs the cost of posting the encrypted design, with or without a dispute. For the 3DBenchy, the no-dispute outcome costs \$7,207 in up to 9 hours on Ethereum, \$288 in 3 min on Arbitrum, and \$2.87 in 2 min on opBNB, and a fully contested dispute costs \$49,660 in up to 57 hours on Ethereum, \$1,988 in 19 min on Arbitrum, and \$19.73 in 13 min on opBNB. Costs and times grow with size: for a 50 MB industrial design, an undisputed service reaches \$56,173 and up to 3 days on Ethereum against \$22.36 and 16 min on opBNB, and a fully contested dispute reaches \$488,440 over up to 18 days on Ethereum against \$195 and 1.6 hours on opBNB. Of the four, the material-consumption check is the costliest, its predicate being the most expensive to evaluate on-chain. OVC makes confidential, claim-based bidding economically feasible on Arbitrum and opBNB, but not on Ethereum at industrial scale.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 去中心化制造面临一个‘信任僵局’：消费者需保护设计文件中的知识产权，而服务提供者又必须查看文件才能准确报价。这构成了Arrow信息悖论的实例：信息无法在不披露的情况下被评估，也无法在披露后仍保持私密。现有方案要么依赖可信中介，要么仅保障交付而非内容真实性，导致前合同阶段缺乏既能保密又能验证的技术手段。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文提出乐观可验证声明（OVC）框架，包含三个主体：消费者、提供者和作为仲裁者的智能合约。消费者发布加密设计并承诺某些属性（如材料消耗），提供者据此出价。若选中后质疑该声明，则触发链上验证流程，通过确定性谓词检查原始文件是否符合承诺。整个机制基于哈希绑定与分段执行，确保诚实路径下无需公开设计。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: OVC实现了声明绑定与可证伪性的分离：承诺在投标阶段确立，仅在争议时才强制披露。实测表明，在Arbitrum和opBNB等高吞吐量链上，6.41MB文件的无争议成本低至2.87美元，争议成本约16.86美元，具备工业可行性；而在以太坊主网则因高昂费用难以落地。语义验证成本超过加密操作，成为性能瓶颈。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者采用模块化设计，将验证拆分为四个独立但一致的检查：密钥访问、通道完整性、语法合规性和特征提取，并通过滚动哈希与分块交易克服单笔交易的Gas上限限制。所有谓词均在Solidity中实现，利用EVM执行保证中立性。成本分析结合真实G-code文件与合成负载，量化各阶段开销。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: OVC的保密性是乐观的——恶意方可通过发起争议迫使披露，尽管代价由挑战者承担。此外，协议不防止物理执行欺诈，也不适用于极低成本任务。最值得阅读的是其将现实工程需求转化为链上可验证逻辑的设计思路，以及对执行层选择决定实用性的深刻洞察。

papers.title: Falling Behind Drives Unsafe Development in an Idealised AI Race Experiment
papers.titleZh: 落后会驱动不安全开发：一个理想化AI竞赛实验
papers.abstract: Technological races create tension between speed and safety: actors may gain by moving faster than competitors, even when risky development is harmful. This is prominent in debates about artificial intelligence (AI), where competitive pressure is often argued to incentivise riskier, less safety-conscious development. We study this using a framed behavioural experiment based on an idealised AI race, in which paired participants repeatedly chose between Safe and Unsafe development under an uncertain time horizon. Unsafe development gave faster progress and higher immediate payoffs but accumulated private risk up to a treatment-specific maximum of 10\%, 60\%, or 90\%; the race's competitive structure was held constant, and only this maximum risk varied. Neither the pre-registered comparison between risk levels nor the role of elicited risk preferences was supported by the data. Instead, exploratory analyses motivated by the task's repeated structure show that Unsafe behaviour is shaped less by risk preferences than by the evolving strategic state of the race: participants are more likely to choose Unsafe after their opponent does so, being ahead reduces Unsafe play while falling behind increases it, and first-round choices predict later behaviour. To interpret these effects we introduce a reduced evolutionary model with four strategies -- Always Safe, Always Unsafe, Conditionally Safe, and Conditionally Antisocial Safe -- which reproduces the treatment effect and shows how conditional Unsafe behaviour can be favoured by competitive race dynamics. Together, the experiment and model show that unsafe development can emerge from early behavioural momentum, opponent behaviour, and fear of falling behind, rather than from risk preferences alone, suggesting policy should focus on reducing competitive pressure and promoting cooperation in AI development rather than only individual risk.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么在AI等关键技术竞赛中，即使意识到风险，参与者仍倾向于选择不安全的开发路径？本文关注‘AI军备竞赛’中的速度与安全权衡问题，挑战了传统观点——即风险偏好是决定行为的主要因素。通过实验发现，真正的驱动力来自竞争动态本身：落后带来的追赶压力、对手的行为模仿以及早期行为惯性，而非个体对风险的天然喜好。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究采用一个理想化的双人重复竞赛实验，参与者在‘安全’与‘不安全’两种开发模式间选择。不安全选项带来更快进展和更高即时收益，但积累个人失败风险，最高风险水平在不同实验组中被设定为10%、60%或90%。游戏持续至少5轮后以20%概率结束，形成不确定终点。两人始终竞争，仅最大风险参数变化，用于分离风险水平与战略状态的影响。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 实验未支持预注册假设：最大风险水平和个体风险偏好均未显著预测不安全行为。相反，探索性分析发现，行为由竞争状态主导：落后时更可能选择不安全；对手上一轮选择不安全会显著增加己方跟随概率；第一轮选择不安全者后续也更倾向冒险。演化模型表明，条件性策略（如‘有条件安全’）能在高风险下胜出，说明战略互动而非静态风险决定了结果。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者结合行为实验与简化演化博弈模型。实验数据通过聚类稳健的面板逻辑回归分析，控制个体特征与风险偏好。演化模型则基于四种策略（始终安全、始终不安全、有条件安全、有条件反社会安全）构建，模拟群体中策略频率的长期动态。通过拟合实验数据，揭示条件响应机制如何在竞争结构下自我维持，即使个体并非天生爱冒险。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 实验虽高度抽象，忽略了多主体、制度干预与系统性风险，但正因简化才凸显了核心机制：竞争压力本身即可诱发不安全行为。其价值不在外部效度，而在揭示‘落后恐惧’与互惠反应的关键作用。最值得读的是其实验设计逻辑与演化模型的衔接方式，展示了如何用行为数据驱动理论模型重构，对AI治理政策设计有深刻启示。

papers.title: Proportional Fairness for Harmful Decisions
papers.titleZh: 有害决策中的比例公平性
papers.abstract: We study allocation of (divisible) public bads, where agents incur costs for alternatives and the goal is to pick a lottery over the alternatives. We show that the traditional definitions of the core, a central criterion of proportional representation for allocation of public goods, private goods, and private bads (chores), do not make sense for allocation of public bads. We introduce two formalizations of the core tailored to public bads. Under a structural condition which subsumes allocation of private bads, we show that zero-respecting Lindahl equilibria satisfy both formalizations, exhibit additional fairness guarantees, and strictly generalize competitive equilibria from equal incomes (CEEI) for allocation of private bads. Without this structural condition, we show that Lindahl equilibria exhibit undesirable behaviors, prove sharp impossibility results separating public bads from public goods, but show that a rule using a reduction to public goods recovers one of our formalizations of the core. Our results lay the groundwork for studying fair allocation of public bads, an overlooked yet fundamental problem, and highlight several structural and algorithmic directions that remain open.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么公共坏物（如污染、负担）的公平分配长期缺乏理论框架？传统公平概念如核心解在公共坏物场景下难以定义，因为任何群体偏离主方案都会影响外部人。论文指出，尽管公共物品、私人物品和私人坏物（家务）已有成熟理论，但公共坏物分配被忽视，其外部性破坏了经典公平原则的适用性。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者将问题建模为在多个替代方案中选择一个彩票，每个代理因不同方案承受线性成本。关键挑战在于如何定义‘核心’：由于无法隔离群体影响，标准定义失效。为此，论文提出两种新核心概念——有界外部性核心与补全核心，并重新定义适用于坏物的林达尔均衡，引入零尊重条件以确保正成本分配。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明，在轴切割实例（每个代理可独自承担全部成本）中，零尊重林达尔均衡满足强个体公平份额并位于两个新核心内，且与私人坏物中的CEEI一致。但在一般情形下，该均衡可能不公平甚至不存在。作为替代，作者提出Flipped-MNW规则，虽在特殊结构中表现较弱，但始终满足补全核心，从而提供普适性保障。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过类比公共物品的纳什福利最大化，转而分析成本向量在向上闭包中的临界点来刻画比例公平。证明依赖于凸优化、KKT条件与超水平集分离技术。对于算法实现，采用贪婪Frank-Wolfe方法求解对偶程序，利用轴切割结构保证收敛，同时借助归约和支撑向量论证建立存在性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 主要局限在于零尊重林达尔均衡仅在特定结构下表现良好，而通用规则Flipped-MNW未能统一所有理想性质。论文价值在于首次系统构建公共坏物分配理论，揭示了外部性对公平的根本挑战。最值得阅读的是其对‘核心’的创新重构、均衡与公平性的深层断裂分析，以及开放问题对未来机制设计的启发。

papers.title: Algorithms for Candidate Control in Greedy Participatory Budgeting Rules
papers.abstract: We study the problem of candidate control in participatory budgeting elections. Our focus is on two prominent sequential welfare-based rules---GreedyAV and GreedyCost---which are widely used in practice. Candidate control asks whether we can strategically modify the set of available candidates so as to either ensure that a preferred candidate $p$ is selected or prevent $p$ from being selected. Since all variants of candidate control under the two rules we consider are known to be NP-hard, we analyze the problems through the lens of parameterized complexity and approximability. Under the first lens, we provide a comprehensive classification with respect to natural parameters such as the number of voters, the number of controlled candidates, and the number of distinct costs, as well as their combinations. Within the second perspective, we establish a tight approximability bound.

papers.title: Beyond Counts: A Distributional Robustness Margin For Pathology Foundation Models
papers.titleZh: 超越计数：病理学基础模型的分布鲁棒性边界
papers.abstract: Pathology foundation models are approaching clinical deployment, yet remain vulnerable to systematic non-biological variation across centres. Differences in tissue preparation, staining and scanning are strongly encoded in their representations, enabling shortcut learning and weakening generalisation across cohorts and institutions. The Robustness Index (RI) quantifies whether local representation geometry is dominated by biology or by non-biological variation, but its count-based formulation discards distance information. We show that adding distance weights changes little because the deeper limitation lies in RI's pooled, fixed-neighbourhood design, which obscures sample-level heterogeneity and effectively evaluates only a model-dependent subset of samples. We introduce the Cross-confounder Robustness Margin (CRoMa), a sample-resolved measure that directly compares distances to cross-confounder biological matches and same-confounder biological distractors. CRoMa recasts robustness as a cohort-wide margin distribution rather than a single pooled score. We evaluated frozen representations from 20 tile-level encoders across three benchmarks and 4 slide-level encoders on a fourth. Rankings by median CRoMa were broadly consistent across datasets, while the underlying distributions revealed substantial within-model heterogeneity. Every tile encoder retained a confounder-dominated lower tail, whose prevalence and severity varied markedly across models. These distinct robustness profiles frame model selection as a Pareto trade-off between typical and lower-tail robustness. Higher CRoMa was also associated with smaller shortcut-induced performance drops after supervised adaptation. By turning representation geometry into a distributional robustness readout that anticipates downstream shortcut susceptibility, CRoMa provides a principled basis for robustness assessment and model selection.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 病理学基础模型虽在临床部署边缘，却极易受不同医疗中心间非生物性技术差异（如染色、扫描）的影响，导致模型依赖数据采集来源而非真实生物学特征进行预测。现有评估方法如Robustness Index（RI）仅统计邻域内样本类别，忽略距离信息，且因固定邻域设计而掩盖样本级异质性，无法全面揭示模型脆弱性。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文在四个病理学基准上评估了20个切片级和4个全片级编码器的表示空间。输入为组织图像块或整张切片，输出为嵌入向量。通过比较每个样本到跨中心同类样本与同中心异类样本的距离，定义新的鲁棒性度量CRoMa。评估不仅看聚合分数，更关注鲁棒性在整个数据集上的分布。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出CRoMa——一种基于距离边际的分布式鲁棒性度量，将评估从单一聚合值转为样本级分布分析。结果显示所有模型均存在‘脆弱尾部’，即部分样本被技术因素主导。模型选择应权衡典型表现与最差情况，而非追求单一高分。CRoMa还能预测下游任务中因捷径学习导致的性能下降。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: CRoMa不再依赖固定大小邻域内的邻居计数，而是直接计算每个样本到最近的跨中心同类样本与同中心异类样本的平均距离之比，生成一个有符号的尺度无关边际值。该设计确保每个样本都有评分，揭示出RI等方法因邻域过小而遗漏的对比信息，并通过分布分析暴露模型内部异质性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: CRoMa依赖于基准中存在足够的跨中心与同中心样本组合，其m值设定虽稳健但仍需人为选择。结论基于特定预训练模型池，可能受预训练数据重叠影响。最值得读的是其对鲁棒性本质的重新思考、CRoMa的设计逻辑及分布视角带来的新洞察，尤其是关于‘无模型完全鲁棒’的经验发现。

papers.title: Desktop-Delta Bench: Do Computer-Use Models Understand Desktop GUI Transitions?
papers.titleZh: Desktop-Delta Bench: 计算机使用模型理解桌面GUI状态转换吗？
papers.abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) increasingly act through desktop GUIs to complete long-horizon tasks. Current benchmarks primarily measure end-task success or single-frame grounding. Neither isolates whether a model can reconstruct the causal, task-relevant transition produced by an action- crucial for rejecting stale observations, verifying progress, and recovering from failure. This is difficult because inference, remote input, app rendering, and screenshot capture are asynchronous: the next observation may be delayed, occluded, transient, or unrelated, then misread as progress and carried into subsequent planning. We introduce Desktop-Delta Bench (DDB), an offline step-level benchmark with 2,013 human-verified instances from novel, multi-app Linux trajectories across ~15 applications and 50 task domains. DDB trajectories targets 3 failure dimensions- state verification, source tracking, and context-aware control- through 2 complementary tasks: 463 3-frame temporal-ordering instances, including 105 with a cross-trajectory decoy, and 1,550 before-after pairs labeled from 5 actions + its payload. We evaluate 8 closed and open-source model families across 32 ordering and 16 single-action settings, observing consistent gaps. Ordering remains unsaturated: best non-decoy and decoy exact-match rates are 65.1% and 65.7%. Task context improves decoy identification by 6.9 percentage points but reduces non-decoy exact match by 2.2 points; error analysis reveals systematic copying of the presented A-B-C order. Single-action results show that inferring the action family is harder than locating it: click F1 is 0.96 vs, 0.76 for drag, while recognized drags are generally localized well. DDB, thus, complements end-to-end benchmarks by filling the missing diagnostic layer between GUI grounding and final task success, enabling targeted improvements to desktop CUA verification, reliability, and recovery.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当前桌面智能体依赖视觉语言模型理解界面变化，但现有评测多关注最终任务成败，无法诊断其是否真正理解操作引发的状态转换。由于系统延迟、弹窗干扰等因素，观察到的画面可能滞后或被污染，导致模型误判进度。若不能识别无效画面或重建因果关系，智能体会积累错误上下文，影响恢复与验证能力，这成为制约可靠性的核心瓶颈。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文提出Desktop-Delta Bench（DDB），一个离线步级评测基准，包含两个互补任务：一是从三个打乱标签的截图中恢复正确时间顺序，并识别是否有一个来自不同轨迹的干扰项；二是根据操作前后的两张截图，推断执行的动作类型及其参数。评测基于人类验证的Linux桌面轨迹，涵盖50类办公任务，输入为图像序列，输出为结构化JSON，评估模型对GUI状态演变的细粒度理解能力。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: DDB填补了从界面感知到任务完成之间的诊断空白，揭示了主流模型在状态转换理解上的显著差距。实验显示，即使最优模型在无干扰排序上仅达65.1%准确率，加入干扰后仍存在识别偏差。任务指令有助于排除干扰但无助于排序本身，且模型普遍存在复制输入顺序的倾向，暴露出深层推理缺陷，说明当前智能体的可靠性基础尚不牢固。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过人工录制带同步事件标记的桌面轨迹，提取高保真动作-画面对，并经双人审核确保标注质量。排序任务要求模型超越像素差异，捕捉语义状态演进；单动作重建则分离动作分类与空间定位，精细刻画失败模式。评测协议控制标签顺序偏置，设置多种推理条件，使结果能反映真实因果建模能力而非表面模式匹配。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: DDB目前局限于Linux环境下的特定应用集合，尚未覆盖Windows/macOS生态及更复杂的工具调用。其短序列设计虽利于诊断，但无法衡量长程上下文累积效应。尽管如此，该工作的问题设定、高质量数据构建和细粒度分析极具启发性，最值得阅读的是其诊断框架设计、人类审核流程与对模型行为偏见的深入剖析，为提升智能体可信度提供了新路径。

papers.title: Forensic Reproducibility Audit of a Radiology Vision-Language Model Benchmark: From Intended Protocol to Released Artifact
papers.titleZh: 放射学视觉-语言模型基准的法医级可重现性审计：从预期协议到发布产物
papers.abstract: Medical-imaging AI benchmarks combine datasets, DICOM rendering, prompts, provider APIs, automated labels, statistical code, manuscripts, and repository releases. Agreement across these artifacts is usually assumed rather than tested. We performed a retrospective forensic reproducibility audit of a preserved chest-radiograph vision-language model (VLM) pilot; no model was called again and no image or report was newly annotated. We traced prompt bindings, DICOM metadata, output completeness, label extraction, matched analyses, and release propagation. Of 300 planned model-prompt calls, 297 yielded nonempty reports. Sixty Claude calls labeled A/B were executed with the same C prompt. The 30 studies represented 28 patients. Four MONOCHROME1 images were rendered without required polarity inversion, dataset split membership was not retained, and the unvalidated extractor truncated five reports to 4000 characters. Reconstructing one common cohort of 369 complete case-finding blocks changed Cochran's Q from 154.73 to 182.29. Of 45 McNemar comparisons, 27 had unadjusted p < 0.05 and 20 remained below 0.05 after Holm adjustment. These values describe only the archived automated-label matrix; they do not recover the intended prompt comparison or establish clinical performance. We withdraw the original performance, ranking, prompt-effect, and clinical claims and specify machine-verifiable controls for cohort, DICOM rendering, prompt and model identity, call status, annotation provenance, keyed analysis, and derived artifacts.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当前医学AI研究常依赖远程调用的视觉-语言模型（VLM），其基准测试涉及代码、提示词、图像渲染和外部API等多个动态环节。尽管已有报告规范，但各组件间的一致性极少被直接检验。本文指出，即使数值可复现，若实际执行与宣称协议不一致，科学结论仍可能无效，核心问题在于缺乏对实验身份的端到端机器可验证追踪。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究并非运行新模型，而是对一个已发布的胸部X光VLM基准进行法医级回溯审计。输入是原始项目快照与公开仓库，输出是对提示词绑定、图像渲染、患者采样、输出完整性及标签提取路径的逐层比对。评估聚焦于协议声明与实际执行间的差异，并通过显式键值配对重建统计结果，而非重新生成临床判断。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 审计发现多项关键偏离：提示词路由错误导致对比失效、四幅图像极性反转、患者重复采样、分割信息丢失、输出截断与配对错位。修正后的统计值虽可计算，但原始性能与提示效应主张已被撤回。最大贡献是揭示‘数值可复现’不等于‘科学可识别’，并提出一个使此类失败在发布前暴露的机器可验证契约框架。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法基于六阶段状态模型（预期、执行、观测、分析、报告、发布），为每个转换定义机器可验的身份检查：如请求文本哈希验证提示一致性、渲染图像哈希确保像素正确性、显式(case, finding)键保障配对无误。通过追溯执行路径、校验文件状态与元数据，区分可修复的算术错误与不可逆的条件身份缺失，从而划定修正边界。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结论受限于单一事后案例，且无法恢复未记录的原始条件。未重跑实验意味着新基准未建立，仅提供失败模式的法证分析。最值得读的是其系统性漏洞分类与契约设计，它揭示了现代AI评测中隐藏的多重断裂点。对重视研究诚信、基准设计与发布工程的研究者极具警示与方法论价值。

papers.title: Schrödinger's Cat: Probabilistic Representation and Prediction of Potential Scene Kinematics
papers.titleZh: 薛定谔的猫：潜在场景运动学的概率表示与预测
papers.abstract: Predicting how a scene may evolve from partial observations requires reasoning about multiple possible futures rather than committing to a single trajectory. Existing approaches either generate appearance-dominated video predictions or sample a small number of trajectories without explicitly modeling the distribution of possible motion. We introduce Goal-Aware Representations of Future kInEmatic Latent Distributions (GARFIELD), a probabilistic model of scene kinematics that learns a structured spatio-temporal latent representation of the distribution over possible futures given an image and optional spatio-temporally sparse constraints. The same latent representation enables both joint sampling of all trajectories and direct access to the underlying motion distribution through an efficient deterministic density decoder. As a result, uncertainty about future motion can be localized to specific scene elements and timesteps and progressively refined through additional constraints. Experiments demonstrate strong motion planning performance competitive with large video generation models while sampling trajectories $97\times$ faster. Our method further estimates motion densities two orders of magnitude faster than Monte-Carlo sampling from motion generation models, enabling interactive exploration and uncertainty-aware planning.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现有视频预测模型通常生成完整的像素序列，耗费大量计算资源于外观细节而非关键运动。同时，多数方法仅采样少数轨迹，无法显式建模未来状态的分布。本文针对开放世界中部分可观测场景的演化问题，指出核心挑战在于如何高效表示并推理多种可能未来的联合分布，尤其是在缺乏密集标注的情况下进行不确定性感知的运动规划。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型以单帧图像和稀疏时空约束（如某些物体在特定时刻的位置）作为输入，输出所有场景元素在未来各时间步的运动概率分布。训练基于大规模视频数据提取的点轨迹，通过扩散式生成目标学习运动规律。评估涵盖开放域运动规划、机器人路径生成和行人轨迹预测，采用端点误差、能量得分等指标衡量轨迹质量与分布校准能力。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出GARFIELD，首次实现了从同一潜变量中既联合采样一致轨迹又直接解码运动密度的双重能力。其密度估计速度比蒙特卡洛采样快两个数量级，在运动规划任务上性能媲美大型视频生成模型的同时，轨迹采样速度快97倍。这表明显式运动建模结合结构化潜空间可显著提升效率与可控性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法的关键在于设计了一个结构化的时空潜表示，其中每个分量对应一个时空位置的运动分布。编码器联合处理整个场景，产生解耦的潜变量；点解码器用于生成单点样本，全解码器则联合采样完整轨迹以保持一致性，而确定性密度解码器可在一次前向传播中输出概率热图，实现无需采样的快速不确定性估计。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型依赖伪真值轨迹训练，其性能受限于追踪器精度；且主要优势体现在已知部分未来约束的交互式规划场景。尽管如此，其将生成模型与密度估计统一的设计思想极具启发性。最值得阅读的是其机制设计与消融分析，展示了结构化潜空间如何平衡表达力与计算效率。

papers.title: HiFi-UMI: Learning Deployable Manipulation Policies from High-Fidelity UMI Data Alone
papers.titleZh: HiFi-UMI：仅从高保真UMI数据中学习可部署的操作策略
papers.abstract: Learning deployable manipulation policies is bottlenecked by the scarcity of data that is both high-fidelity and scalable. Real-robot teleoperation is accurate but costly to scale; robot-free UMI capture scales readily, and current practice uses the resulting data mainly for pre-training, adding a small real-robot "anchor" at post-training. We ask whether raising the fidelity of robot-free UMI data, rather than shrinking the real-robot fraction, can remove that anchor. We present HiFi-UMI, a portable UMI data-production system co-designed for trajectory accuracy, inter-gripper relative pose, synchronization, and field of view: head-mounted offline stereo-inertial SLAM, native rather than reconstructed relative pose, a shared microsecond GPIO trigger, and two wide-angle cameras per hand covering ~200 degrees. It reaches 3 mm workspace-local end-effector accuracy without external tracking infrastructure. Using this corpus, we demonstrate zero-robot post-training: a policy post-trained solely on HiFi-UMI demonstrations deploys directly on a real robot and matches in-domain teleoperation across three backbones spanning the vision-language-action and world-action-model families, with success-rate differences of -2.5, +3.1, and -0.6 percentage points on StarVLA-QwenPI, OpenPI-pi_0.5, and LingBot-VA; the strongest policy reaches 85% on a precision insertion task, even though the teleoperation baseline is collected in the evaluation scene and no HiFi-UMI trajectory is. Pre-training on 4,000 hours from the same corpus lowers action error on ten unseen tasks by 41% and, on StarVLA-QwenPI, raises real-robot success by a further 18.1 percentage points. We open-source HiFi-UMI-2K, 2,000 hours of microsecond-synchronized, ultra-wide-FoV demonstrations, each automatically reconstructed and validated through simulation replay, as a large-scale, high-fidelity resource for the robot-learning community.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当前可部署的机器人操作策略受限于高质量数据的稀缺。真实机器人遥操作虽精准但难以扩展，而无需机器人的UMI（通用操作接口）数据因轨迹漂移、同步差和视野盲区等问题，通常只能用于预训练，仍需少量真实机器人数据进行后训练来‘锚定’策略。本文质疑这一必要性：是否可以通过提升UMI数据本身的保真度，完全摆脱对真实机器人数据的依赖？
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文研究在不使用任何真实机器人演示的情况下，能否仅靠高保真UMI数据完成策略的后训练并直接部署。输入是人类通过手持设备在各种环境中录制的多视角视频与传感器数据，输出是可执行的机器人动作序列。作者构建了HiFi-UMI系统采集数据，并在四个双臂操作任务上测试三种主流策略模型，比较仅用UMI数据后训练与传统遥操作后训练的性能差异。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文首次证明，仅使用高保真UMI数据进行后训练，即可达到与真实机器人遥操作相当的部署性能，差距在采样噪声范围内（±3.1个百分点），实现了真正的‘零机器人后训练’。此外，基于同一数据集的预训练显著提升了下游任务的数据效率和最终表现，验证了高质量纯人类数据的价值，挑战了必须依赖真实机器人数据才能部署的传统认知。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 为确保数据保真度，HiFi-UMI系统采用头戴式离线立体惯性SLAM获取低漂移轨迹，通过固定标记物原生测量双手相对位姿，使用硬件GPIO触发实现微秒级多传感器同步，并配备超广角双相机消除视野盲区。整个数据引擎自动完成轨迹重建、仿真回放验证和标注，确保输出数据可靠，从而让策略能直接信任并学习这些无机器人数据。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 核心结论建立在特定双臂桌面任务和四种场景上，其泛化性有待验证；未通过消融实验分离各保真度因素的独立贡献，无法量化每项改进的具体影响；对比并非样本量匹配，UMI数据量远超遥操作，因此不能断言其单位数据效率更高。最值得阅读的是其系统设计思路和‘零机器人后训练’的实证，为低成本、大规模机器人数据采集提供了新范式。
